Bug Title: Check the NetSuite database upgrade was applied
Test Steps:
1. (DB, read-only) List the latest database upgrades.
2. Look for upgrades 10.2 and 10.3.
Expected Result(s):
- The NetSuite database changes are in place: sync status, error message, NetSuite reference and number on invoices and credit notes
- No failed database upgrade
Actual Result(s): Database of this environment: the NetSuite fields on invoices and credit notes and the new NetSuite queue are in place; no failed database upgrade

2. Read the invoice type and location settings (Q3).

- Department: DEFAULT 15, PHC 135, FONATEL 137

Bug Title: Check Embrix can sign in to NetSuite
Test Steps:
1. Customer Activity > open the NetSuite call (CREATE_INVOICE) of an invoice.
2. Read NetSuite's answer.
Expected Result(s): - NetSuite answers with a business result (accepted, or a business error such as "missing customer"), never a sign-in error
Actual Result(s): NetSuite answered 200: invoice 0279580 → 1087495 / FA585964

Bug Title: Check an exemption % with no NetSuite tax code is stopped in Embrix
Test data: Test customer with an exemption such as 50%
Test Steps:
1. Set the exemption (e.g. 50%) on a test customer.
2. Invoice the customer.
Expected Result(s): - Embrix shows an error naming the invoice, line, rate and exemption; nothing sent to NetSuite
Actual Result(s): Invoice 0279594 with a 50% exemption is not sent to NetSuite; the Invoicing report shows the reason: "no NetSuite tax code for IVA 650.00 on 10000.00 (rate 6.50%, 6.50 of the 13 IVA points exempted; customer exemption 50.00%)"

Bug Title: Check an exemption stored with extra decimals still maps correctly
Test Steps:
1. Set the exemption to 84.615385.
2. Create a manual invoice.
3. Read the Internet tax code.
Expected Result(s): - Tax code 10 (84.615385 is treated as 84.62); never 0
Actual Result(s): Exemption stored as 84.615385% → tax code 10 (invoice 0279591); never 0

Bug Title: Check a successful invoice keeps its NetSuite reference after later actions
Test data: Standard test customer 208886 (NetSuite customer 74003): manual invoice, Internet 10,000
Test Steps:
1. Create the manual invoice; wait for NetSuite.
2. Bills: read Finance Sync Status / Ref Id / Version.
3. Refresh, e-mail the invoice, regenerate it, then credit it.
4. Re-read the three fields after each step.
Expected Result(s):
- SUCCESS with the NetSuite id and invoice number
- The values do not change after any later action
Actual Result(s): Invoice 0279580: SUCCESS, ref 1087495 / FA585964 kept after refresh and after Email invoice

Bug Title: Check a rejection keeps NetSuite's message over time
Test data: New test customer without a NetSuite customer number (Coopeweb API)
Test Steps:
1. Create the customer without a NetSuite customer number.
2. Create a manual invoice for it.
3. Bills: read the status and error.
4. Read again 30 seconds later.
Expected Result(s):
- ERROR with NetSuite's message word for word
- No NetSuite id; invoice ACTIVE; the message is still there later
Actual Result(s): Invoice 0279606 (contract without Party Id): sync ERROR with NetSuite's message word for word ("Elementos requeridos faltantes en la solicitud: entity"), no NetSuite id, invoice ACTIVE; the message is still there on a later read

Bug Title: Check a re-sent invoice replaces the old error with the new result
Test data: The rejected invoice from ENG-007-02, after setting NetSuite customer 57936
Test Steps:
1. Set the NetSuite customer number 57936 on the customer.
2. Bills > Action > SYNC_INVOICE.
3. Read status, error and what was sent.
Expected Result(s):
- Re-sent with the new customer number
- The old error is replaced by NetSuite's new answer (on SUCCESS: error cleared, NetSuite id saved)
Actual Result(s): Re-send of invoice 0279598: "queued for NetSuite", sent with the corrected customer; the stored result is replaced by NetSuite's new answer (test contracts are unknown to NetSuite, so their invoices are answered "contract not found")
Note: Jeremy fix (ENG-007). SUCCESS path needs an ERROR invoice on a contract NetSuite knows

Bug Title: Check a logging failure does not lose the NetSuite result
Test Steps:
1. (Dev) Make the activity log fail.
2. Send one invoice that succeeds and one that fails.
3. QA reads both invoices in Bills.
Expected Result(s):
- Status, NetSuite id and error are saved even without a log entry
- The logging failure is reported in the server logs
Actual Result(s): Dev: covered by the code tests (an activity row that cannot be written keeps the status, NetSuite id and error). Cannot be caused from the screen

Bug Title: Check a failed re-send cannot overwrite a successful invoice
Test Steps:
1. (Dev) Force a re-send of the successful invoice.
2. Read status, NetSuite id and error.
Expected Result(s): - Still SUCCESS with the same NetSuite id; no second NetSuite record
Actual Result(s): Dev forced a re-send of 0279698 (798166, FA586029): refused with "Already in NetSuite: FA586029", nothing sent. Embrix: still SUCCESS, NetSuite number FA586029, one CREATE_INVOICE call only. NetSuite sandbox: one invoice FA586029 (customer CLI104915, 01/11/2027, open, 530,083.63)
Note: Pairs with INV-005. The UI does not offer SYNC_INVOICE on a SUCCESS invoice

Bug Title: Check two credit notes in a row each keep their own customer
Test data: 208886 (74003), then Coope contract 244822 (65730), both with invoices already in NetSuite
Test Steps:
1. Credit an invoice on 208886.
2. Straight after, credit an invoice on the 57936 customer.
3. Read the customer in both NetSuite calls.

Actual Result(s): 208886: CR-105186 sent with customer "74003" (NC1012); straight after, 244822: CR-105187 sent with customer "65730" (NC1013). Nothing carried over.

Bug Title: An invoice already in NetSuite cannot be sent again
Test Steps:
1. Bills > select the invoice > Action list.
2. Send the same resend request the screen uses, directly to the server.
3. Search the invoice number in the NetSuite sandbox.
Expected Result(s):
- The screen does not offer SYNC_INVOICE
- The server refuses the resend
- NetSuite holds the invoice once
Actual Result(s): The screen offers EMAIL_INVOICE, EXTEND_DUE_DATE and REGENERATE_INVOICE only; the server answers "Already in NetSuite: FA586064" and sends nothing; FA586064 is found once in the NetSuite sandbox.

Bug Title: Credits beyond the open amount, on closed invoices, and two credits on one invoice
Test Steps:
1. Apply Adjustment: credit 800 on 0279769, then 2,000 on 0279769.
2. Credit 100 on 0279770.
3. Two credits (50, 60) on 0279768.
Expected Result(s):
- Credits are limited to what is open; closed invoices are refused with a clear message
- Each credit note reaches NetSuite once
Actual Result(s): 800 on 573.50 due: accepted as "Apply Adjustment successfully!" but credited only 573.50 (CR-105193, NC1019) with no message that it was reduced. 2,000 on the then closed invoice and 100 on the paid invoice: refused, "Credit adjustment on closed invoice not allowed". Two credits on 0279768: CR-105194 57.37 (NC1020) and CR-105195 68.85 (NC1021), both in NetSuite (amounts entered before tax).
Note: Suggestion: tell the agent when a credit is reduced to the open amount. tests/dev/ns-edge-cases.spec.ts (EDGE-CREDIT)

Bug Title: Invoices NetSuite refused show the reason and can be sent again
Test data: Refused invoices other than "contract not found"
Test Steps: 1. Bills > the refused invoice: Finance Error Message and Action list.
Expected Result(s):
- NetSuite's message is shown on the invoice
- SYNC_INVOICE is offered to send it again
Actual Result(s): Shown on each: e.g. missing customer (entity), invalid field value, no open fiscal period for the invoice date, no item line, and the Embrix check "no NetSuite tax code for IVA 650.00"; SYNC_INVOICE is offered on all of them.
